checks.text:
FIVE INDEPENDENT WORLDS

NIGHTGLASS COURIER

Where the Replies Wait

At Ninth Store, Aren accepts one waiting reply. Its recipient has already made a choice in the silence.

Chapter 2
Chapter 3
Chapter 4
Chapter 5
Begin reading ↓

The next morning. After the collection run.

Same time tomorrow?

AREN
Same time.

To Venn at the bindery. He pays the crate fee.

AREN
I’ll bring your barrow back.

The carrying fee. Thank you.

VENN
I can show you the room tomorrow, after closing.

AREN
I’ll come with Kiva.

Tomorrow after closing. I’ll come with you.

Ninth Store.

SERA
Mern sent us.

TOMA
Then you found the right stack.

TOMA
Ilen asked yesterday: send hers to the west drying loft.

We receive the redirects. We have no workplace round.

AREN
I can take hers.

The ordinary carrying fee when you bring her receipt.

I’ll get the current direction while you deliver.

AREN
I’ll meet you here.

Ilen?

ILEN
At the frame. Give me a moment.

Ninth Store?

AREN
They sent your reply.

I can sign without opening it?

AREN
Of course.

AREN
That’s the delivery done.

Can you wait until the break?

AREN
I have time.

My daughter’s shop opened last week. She asked me to come.

I thought she didn’t want me there.

I signed on for the next season. I’m keeping it.

I can come back another day.

ILEN
It won’t need another day.

I can visit on my rest day. If she still wants me.

Prepaid. For her current address.

I’ll put it on the next post.

Ilen received it.

The carrying fee, as agreed.

The old direction is still in use. Only Route Closures can replace it.

The current direction. One completed delivery. Enough to ask for a change.

Next outgoing round.

Venn can show me the bindery room tomorrow.

OSSA
See it. You can ask about ours after your week.

End of Chapter 5
